-- Struct declare @q nvarchar(max), @s nvarchar(max)
SELECT TOP 0 @q AS xkey INTO #t1
SELECT @qn = REPLACE(@qn, '''', ''), @qn2 = REPLACE(@qn2, '''', ''), @qn3 = REPLACE(@qn3, '''', ''), @qn4 = REPLACE(@qn4, '''', ''), @qn5 = REPLACE(@qn5, '''', ''), @qn6 = REPLACE(@qn6, '''', ''), @qn7 = REPLACE(@qn7, '''', ''), @qn8 = REPLACE(@qn8, '''', ''), @qn9 = REPLACE(@qn9, '''', ''), @qn10 = REPLACE(@qn10, '''', '')
SET @s = 'DECLARE @i INT' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = 1' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'WHILE @i <= dbo.ff_GetWordCount(''@IDNumber'') BEGIN' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'INSERT INTO #t1 SELECT dbo.ff_GetWordNum(''@IDNumber'', @i)' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'SET @i = @i + 1' SET @s = @s + CHAR(13) + 'END'
SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn) EXEC sp_executesql @q
IF @qn2 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn2); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn3 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn3); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn4 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn4); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn5 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn5); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn6 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn6); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn7 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn7); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn8 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn8); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn9 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn9); EXEC sp_executesql @q END IF @qn10 <> '' BEGIN SET @q = REPLACE(@s, '@IDNumber', @qn10); EXEC sp_executesql @q END
alter table #t1 add crm_ma_dat_cho nvarchar(max), stt_rec char(13), stt_rec0 char(3) update #t1 set crm_ma_dat_cho = left(xkey, charindex('$', xkey) - 1), stt_rec = substring(xkey, charindex('$', xkey) + 1, 13), stt_rec0 = right(xkey, 3)
select top 0 a.* into #$d29$view from d29$000000 a right join (select null b) b on 1 = 0
declare @field varchar(64), @message nvarchar(512) exec zrs_zGenerateHD9$Posting$Post2GL 'KOG_FBISP24_S', 'v', 1, 1, @field out, @message out, @ngay_ct, @dien_giai, @ma_quyen, @status, @ma_nghiep_vu, 1
declare @$baseCurrency varchar(3) select top 1 @$baseCurrency = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select top 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nt into #$cttt20 from cttt20 select top 0 stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nt into #$cttt30 from cttt30 select top 0 tk into #$ar from dmtk select top 0 tk into #$ap from dmtk
select @@fieldExternal from #$d29$view a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join #$cttt20 d on a.stt_rec_tt2 = d.stt_rec left join #$cttt30 e on a.stt_rec_tt3 = e.stt_rec left join #$ar f on a.tk = f.tk left join #$ap g on a.tk = g.tk &ESG.queryLoading; order by line_nbr
